fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. The LORD says, “After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.” (Jeremiah 16:16) First fishermen, then hunters. Nowhere to hide, not even in the cracks of the rocks.

Right, baker. The LORD says, “For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.” (Jeremiah 16:17) Not some of their ways, but all of them. So the answer is False, because none of their ways are hidden from Him.
